_meta.description: Event table, owned by Member 2. Batch 1 contains 14 events across hazard, discovery, crew, equipment, and opportunity categories. Trigger rates and numeric effects are editable gameplay-balance values; expand to ~15-20 total before handoff to Member 1 for trigger-system integration.

events.trigger_condition: random_chance: 8% per sol after sol 3 and rover_or_eva_activity
events.text: Lunar dust has accumulated on the solar arrays, reducing the light reaching their cells until the arrays are cleaned or the effect expires.
Sensors detect an incoming solar particle event. Crew must shelter immediately.

choices.text: Shelter in the shielded module
Push through to finish current task

events.text: The rover detects a hydrogen-rich volatile prospect. It may contain water ice, but the signal must be investigated before the outpost can plan extraction.

choices.text: Schedule a rover prospecting mission
Mark the prospect and continue the mission

events.trigger_condition: random_chance: 6% per sol if structure_age > 10 sols
events.text: A key system is malfunctioning and running below capacity until repaired.

choices.text: Divert crew time to repair immediately
Let it run at reduced capacity

events.text: Tensions rise under the pressure of outpost life.

choices.text: Spend a sol mediating
Let them work it out

events.text: An unexpectedly strong crop cycle boosts food output for a while.
A micrometeorite strikes the outpost, damaging a structure.
A filter in the water-recovery loop is clogging faster than expected. The crew can spend time restoring the system or accept reduced recovery temporarily.

choices.text: Assign the engineer to service the recycler
Ration water until the next maintenance window

events.trigger_condition: rover_action: traverse AND random_chance: 10% per action
events.text: The rover finds a patch of soft regolith and loses traction. Continuing risks wasting power, while retreating leaves the route unexplored.

choices.text: Use a careful recovery route
Return to base and remap the route

events.text: Battery temperature control is drawing extra reserve power. The outpost can protect the battery or keep all systems running at higher risk.

choices.text: Enter a one-sol conservation mode
Maintain normal operations

events.text: A rover survey identifies a nearby regolith deposit suitable for shielding fill. Hauling it now could make radiation protection cheaper later.

choices.text: Stockpile the regolith near the habitat
Keep the rover on its current survey

events.text: The local terrain is receiving an unusually favorable illumination window. The outpost can bank energy or use the surplus for a demanding task.

choices.text: Prioritize battery charging
Use the surplus for deferred operations

events.trigger_condition: sol >= 4 AND crew_stress_avg < 0.45 AND random_chance: 10% per sol
events.text: A quiet review of the outpost routine produces a better shift handoff. For a short time, the crew can complete work with less friction.

choices.text: Adopt the improved schedule
Keep the current routine

events.text: A scheduled resupply delivery arrives, adding to your materials stockpile.
